body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Motorola introduced its social skills 'CLIQ' at CES. It has a full HTML browser, 3G/HSDPA and Wi-Fi and features syncs contacts, messages, feeds and updates from today´s most popular social sites.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
